title: Ion Distribution at Rest
text: At rest, the neuron maintains higher Na+ concentration outside and higher K+ concentration inside (maintained by the sodium-potassium pump). This creates the resting potential of -70mV. When stimulated, specific ion channels open.

title: Voltage-Gated Channels
text: Voltage-gated channels open in response to changes in membrane potential. Sodium channels open first at threshold. Sodium ions carry a positive charge, so when they enter the cell, the inside becomes more positive - this is called depolarisation (DE-polarisation = removing the negative polarity).
